name: Call of the Sky
author: ZeldaWWHDRecomp contributors
description: SDK v2 example prototype: an optional Dragon Roost song quest and Valoo ride across the Great Sea.

setup.title: Build Call of the Sky for this installation

start.text: After helping Valoo, with the Deku Leaf: check a Rito postbox for Medli's letter.

reward.text: The song "Call of the Sky": Valoo answers you over the Great Sea

steps.text: Meet Medli at Dragon Roost Island's high entrance.
steps.where: Dragon Roost Island, the high entrance

steps.text: Strike the three wind chimes: by the harbor, on the cliff and at the lookout.
Return to Medli and conduct the chimes' notes.
steps.where: Dragon Roost Island, the high entrance
